entries.2c38d516098e16a2: The company has formulated the long-term vision 'ASKA VISION 2035' and the Medium-Term Management Plan 2028, starting in April 2026, and states that it aims to achieve both sustainable growth and the resolution of social issues. Under the Medium-Term Management Plan 2028, the 'five pillars' are: expanding the specialty area in domestic prescription pharmaceutical business; promoting global expansion in the drug discovery business; strengthening the foundation of global business through the operation of the new plant in Vietnam; expanding the animal health business; and developing the testing and Around-Pill businesses.

entries.4055bf0eba4ddadf: The company focuses on three fields: internal medicine, obstetrics and gynecology, and urology. In obstetrics and gynecology it has key products such as the uterine fibroid and endometriosis treatment 'Relmina' and the dysmenorrhea treatment 'Doroechi', and in internal medicine it has key products such as the thyroid hormone agent 'Chiradin'. Aiming to become a leading company in specialty fields such as obstetrics and gynecology, it is advancing research and development and licensing-out and licensing-in activities.
